4336-5006-8095-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
4336-5006-8095-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

856-4321-6462-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-6462-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Kheru Goldkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2137-4642-7175.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4642-7175.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

2440-8159.notablePrerequisites: You control three in any combination of Wizards and/or Soldiers.
2440-8159.description:
Activate Ingris by paying {4}, creating a 2/2 Cadet creature token and giving creatures you control haste until end of turn.
When the Cadet enters, it triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that is a Wizard or Soldier.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Declare all Cadets as attackers. Ingris triggers that many times, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to each opponent.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1339-1832-4050-6578.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-6578.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

687-2034-7905.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two additional counters of any kind on Tayam or another creature you control.
687-2034-7905.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rhovanion Rampager, adding {C}{C}.
When Rhovanion Rampager dies, it creates a creature token with at least three counters on it, including a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing one counter from the creature token and two counters from other creature you control, milling three cards and returning Rhovanion Rampager from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Tayam again by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from Rhovanion Rampager and two counters from the creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Rhovanion Rampager and the creature token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Rhovanion Rampager dies, it creates a creature token with at least three counters on it, including a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling yourself three cards and returning Rhovanion Rampager from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.
687-2034-7905.notes: This order of operations and the additional {2} starting mana is necessary because you must activate mana abilities like Ashnod's Altar's before paying the counter removal cost.

1086-1981-2415-2921.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1086-1981-2415-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1887-2021-2060-5902.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
5147-6972-7804.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Captain Kathryn Janeway.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway enters, it triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Kathryn Janeway.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

650-3175-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3525-4028-6723.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {U}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

969-1563-3129-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

625-3814-6871.description:
Give the artifact type to Argothian Elder using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat step 2.

250-779-1315-1479-2692.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-2692.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1409-2895-3147-6763.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1409-2895-3147-6763.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

826-2178-2511-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it and Amoeboid Changeling trigger.
Resolve the Amoeboid Changeling trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Otherworldly Escort trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2792-3647-4477.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2792-3647-4477.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa and Great Whale
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
2792-3647-4477.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

4659-5113-5220.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
Realmwalker has a creature type noted that is found on the nontoken creature mentioned above.
4659-5113-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2173-4771-5220-6794.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1167-6871.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Mindslaver to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Toph triggers, returning Mindslaver from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mindslaver ability, causing you to gain control of an opponent during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

1445-2438-4871-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2438-4871-5632.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

440-1339-2741-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2741-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2099-3604-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
2099-3604-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
When Lonis enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Lonis.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.
2099-3604-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

2972-4094-5456.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three Treasures.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2972-4094-5456.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Magda by sacrificing three Treasures, creating two 4/4 Scorpion Dragon creature tokens with flying and haste.
When the Scorpion Dragons enter the battlefield, Ganax triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

112-3152-5570.notablePrerequisites:
Nardole has at least four counters on it.
Nardole does not have summoning sickness.
112-3152-5570.description:
Activate Nardole by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Nardole.
Resolve Clockspinning, putting a counter on Nardole, or putting/removing a counter from any other permanent you control, and then returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells, you may target any other creature using Chakram Retriever's trigger.

647-1069-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
647-1069-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

2486-4613-5507.notablePrerequisites:
You control another creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
2486-4613-5507.description:
Activate another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by exiling it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Repeat using the Human token instead.

1575-4231-4779.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1575-4231-4779.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

91-2991-5112-5284.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
91-2991-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Mairsil dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Lunar Avenger's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Repeat.

549-1558-1991.notablePrerequisites: Tana has power five or greater, does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
549-1558-1991.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tana.
Tana triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Saprolings, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1306-2303-2538-3661.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand whenever you would next draw a card this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Vedalken Archmage triggers, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand, with you returning Mana Crypt, due to Words of Wind.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand whenever you would next draw a card this turn.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Vedalken Archmage triggers, causing each player to return a permanent from the battlefield to their hand, with you returning Shield Sphere, due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.

2026-2404-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Voyaging Satyr.
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four creatures.
2026-2404-5200.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat.

539-1682-4657.easyPrerequisites: You control two mana-producing lands other than Magus of the Candelabra.
539-1682-4657.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers twice, adding {2}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

2018-4053-4487.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.
2018-4053-4487.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
